messages:
Alexa: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window deploy tomorrow 2024-04-02 02:00 UTC. This touches API, runtime, console, and router. Need explicit version pins and rollback criteria before we lock the window. Acknowledge and call out any cross-service blockers.

Ben: Ack. Which runtime build are we pinning to? kernel-v2-quant vs kernel-v2-qat? Need to know for perf profiling.

Carla: +1 need the canary plan. I propose 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m with 10m soak at each step. Will require a router header-split and API route pin.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: deploybot/quiet-window/2024-04-02T02:00Z queued by Alexa. Runbook: /deploy preflight -> canary -> promote. See https://ci.redwood/internal/12456

Dinesh: Flag: runtime kernel-v2-qat changed KV eviction heuristics last week. If we push default settings we might see higher misses under burst. Please set kv.eviction_limit or we should hold canary to low qps.

Eva: Console contract change: adding optional "session_id" to /v1/sessions responses (non-breaking). Router's route-matcher is strict on schema in staging; can someone confirm router tolerates unknown fields? I can run a quick integration test.

Ben: runtime=kernel-v2-qat-20240401 (finalized), verified perf locally. API pinned to v2.3.1 because of new header routing.

Carla: Canary traffic plan: use header X-Release-Tag: canary-2042 and router rule:
```
match: header("X-Release-Tag") == "canary-2042" -> route to runtime:kernel-v2-qat-20240401
```
Will orchestrate header injection via API gateway for 5% of users.

Dinesh: Suggested runtime config snippet to avoid KV thrash:
```
kv:
  max_entries: 3000000
  eviction_policy: lru
  eviction_guard: true
```
Please add to the pinned runtime config.

Frank: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- error rate (5xx) > 1.0% for 10m OR
- p95 latency increase > 40ms vs baseline for 10m OR
- memory OOMs / pod restarts > 1 per node in 5m
If triggered, immediate traffic cut to previous pinned variants + alert SRE.

Eva: Ran a quick router integration against staging: router accepts unknown fields, console change is safe.

Carla: Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/456 — includes canary rollout steps and monitoring links.

Alexa: I'm going to push pins now. Pin commit includes:
```
api: v2.3.1
runtime: kernel-v2-qat-20240401
console: v1.8.0
router: v3.4.2
runtime_config: \"kv.max_entries=3000000, eviction_policy=lru\"
```
Commit: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/0f4a2b

Ben: I updated perf dashboards to include p95, p99, 5xx rate, error-type breakdown, and KV hit-rate. Dash links in release notes PR.

Dinesh: Also adding a short smoke test list for deploy bot to run after canary promote (kv hit-rate > 90%, avg latency < baseline + 20ms, no 5xx).

DeployBot: Preflight checks passed (lint, unit-tests). Integration tests queued (approx 8m).

Frank: One more: console UI feature flag toggled to off-by-default behind ff/release-2042 until 25% step finishes.

Alexa: Thanks all. If no further objections I'll start the change window tomorrow. If any team needs a longer hold for manual checks, call it out now. :thumbsup:

Carla: No blockers from release engineering. We'll monitor the canary channel and be ready to cut. :rocket:

Ben: Ready to initiate header split at T+0.

Alexa: Closing here — will post final pin commit & deploybot schedule in #deploy-notifications when queued.
